label: Process
description: A BFO process (occurrent): an entity that unfolds in time, e.g. an observation, a program execution, a governance activity.

label: Independent Continuant
description: A BFO independent continuant: a bearer of qualities that persists through time.

label: Artifact
description: A CCO artifact: an object intentionally made to realize a function (instruments, systems, datasets-as-objects).

label: Information Content Entity
description: A CCO information content entity: a generically dependent continuant that is about, or carries information concerning, some entity.

label: Descriptive Information Content Entity
description: An ICE that describes an entity or state of affairs (measurements, records, observations).

label: Directive Information Content Entity
description: An ICE that prescribes or directs (plans, rules, requirements, policies).

label: Designative Information Content Entity
description: An ICE that designates or names an entity (identifiers, codes, keys).

label: Generic Entity
description: Foundational / domain-agnostic axiom patterns without a specific BFO/CCO anchor.
